title: If-Clauses with SE
summary: Build real, possible, and unreal conditions with se plus the right tense.

sections.heading: Real future conditions
sections.body: For future conditions that may really happen, use **se + future subjunctive** in the condition and present, future, imperative, or ir + infinitive in the result.

examples.pt: Se chover, vou ficar em casa.
examples.en: If it rains, I will stay home.

examples.pt: Se você tiver dúvida, me pergunte.
examples.en: If you have a question, ask me.

examples.pt: Se eles chegarem cedo, começamos a reunião.
examples.en: If they arrive early, we start the meeting.

sections.heading: Hypothetical present or future
sections.body: For less likely or imaginary conditions, use **se + imperfect subjunctive** and the **conditional** in the result.

examples.pt: Se eu ganhasse na loteria, compraria uma casa.
examples.en: If I won the lottery, I would buy a house.

examples.pt: Se ela pudesse, moraria perto da família.
examples.en: If she could, she would live near her family.

examples.pt: Se nós tivéssemos mais tempo, faríamos melhor.
examples.en: If we had more time, we would do it better.

sections.heading: Unreal past
sections.body: For past conditions that did not happen, use **se + tivesse + participle** and **teria + participle** in the result.

examples.pt: Se eu tivesse estudado, teria passado.
examples.en: If I had studied, I would have passed.

examples.pt: Se você tivesse avisado, eu teria esperado.
examples.en: If you had told me, I would have waited.

examples.pt: Se eles tivessem saído cedo, não teriam perdido o voo.
examples.en: If they had left early, they would not have missed the flight.

keyPoints: Unreal past: se + pluperfect subjunctive + conditional perfect.
Do not use the future tense immediately after se for conditions.

commonMistakes.wrong: Se vai chover, fico em casa.
commonMistakes.note: Use future subjunctive after se for future conditions.
The se-clause uses subjunctive, not conditional.

commonMistakes.wrong: Se eu tinha estudado, teria passado.
commonMistakes.right: Se eu tivesse estudado, teria passado.
